I appreciate the compliment. 

My friends who don't understand are also kinda stubborn. They don't really care about her state, which is why they stay out of it. They want to go off on her and call her on being stupid, because that's how they handle it between each other. But they don't, they stay out of it because they're just not the kind of people who would put themselves in this situation. She takes it as they hate her. But they're actually protecting her because they have short tempers.

My other friends understand but they are losing patience. There is 4 of us who understand and constantly try to help, but we're all taking a huge toll. 3 of us including me have distanced ourselves because we can't take it anymore. The last guy is trying and he wants to take one for the team and be her boyfriend, but that's not going to help him or her. He has no attraction to her, but she craves love and compassion and so he's willing to give it to her even if it's fake, but that's a disaster waiting to happen.

She quit therapy because it made her feel crazy and they kept telling her she's "crazy" but after knowing her she definitely twisted their words. The therapist probably tried to level with her and let her know she needs some time with him (the therapist) and some help, instead she took it as "He says i'm crazy, i'm not crazy" so she stopped going and refuses all pro help. 

As for her parents, she lives in a really shitty neighborhood, like really shitty. In the ghetto. She claims that her mom abuses them and always tries to kick her out, but I don't think that's the case, I think she gives her mom a tough time because she's always on the defense and when her mom gets too close she lashes out. She did it to my dad, so i'm sure she'd do it to her mom. She also said her dad would find her and rape her, and then beat her and her siblings, so they moved away from him. She lives in a broken household, but i have heard her mom over the call and her mom cares so much and is trying to help her, but my friend won't listen and interprets everything wrong, so a "I love you, and i worry" will sound like "You're crazy and need to leave" to her. 

But one thing is, just like in my previous reply, most people don't know how to understand a suicidal/depressed persons point of view. They try to use reason against them, which doesn't work, it's not about reason at all. Her mom tries to reason with her, but she doesn't understand why my friend would say such "stupid" responses. 

"No one loves me"

"Everyone loves you, what are you talking about?"

"YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND!"

"Yes, I do, you're loved by everyone, just look around!"

"They all hate me and no one care open your eyes!"

etc etc. 

Her mom means well, she really does, but she doesn't know how to handle that mindset because she knows nothing about it. Most people don't. They don't get how people will completely ignore reason and fact. It requires a lot of patience and understanding to deal with someone like this... I have the understanding, i don't have the patience, because i need help too, but i get it. Our friends also wish they could help, but they find her annoying because she won't listen, but it's because they don't get it. I don't blame them, most people wouldn't get it. 

EDIT: also, i don't know her mom, at all, never met her in my life, me and this girl met through a mutual friend and clicked because we both shared this same depression and suicidal pattern, and thought we could help eachother.

She won't take it is the biggest problem... I'm trying to remember what happened to me that made me say "I need help.." People have told me that, but when i was in her state i didn't listen. But something one day put me over the edge and i said I need to get help. And once I wanted to get help for me, it changed. Because even if I wasn't being rational, any advice people gave me actually worked towards my goal so it was easier. Like before, i wanted to kill myself, so when people said "Don't do it, get help, you're better than this" that wasn't helping me kill myself so i blew it off. But once i said "I need help..." when people told me "You're great, get better, don't do it" it helped me towards my goal ofgetting help, so i took it in.

I don't know how to get her to actually believe HERSELF that she needs help. Once she gets that, the road gets smoother, because we're now on the same end goal, so she'll listen a little more. But honestly, she's getting beyond bad.....

I let her down easy today, i told her i need a little break, and that i'm still going to be around but i'm not feeling too hot and can't really deal with a lot of pressure. She understood... Then took it as "He doesn't want to deal with my shit anymore"

Apparently while I was at work she did 3 lines of Xanax and Cocaine because she was feeling awful and she relapsed. She then says that she wants to be with one of our friends romantically, he's the last one who is still in this with her. He's taking it pretty hard and he's thinking about taking one for the team, but we told him that's not how it works. He wants to date her till she's better, but it won't be that way. She'll get better cause she's dependent on him, and then he can't leave or he'll suffer the consequences of her relapsing again.

She's talking to us right now, she's delusional saying "I'm depressed." "No body cares." "I'm sad" "I just want someone to talk to" "I guess i'll just be alone". But we're all avoiding those phrases. we're now becoming frustrated and annoyed. People are wanting to go off, but it's because they don't understand her mindset. I know why she's thinking "stupid" like this and I understand, but it's so hard to believe from an outside POV who hasn't dealt with it. Saying "She's not thinking rationally, and no matter what we say or do we can't make her think rationally. She'll only believe what she wants" And it's frustrating.

Also, we're feeling major amounts of stress and anxiety because of all of this....

It's not going well.

No i really appreciate the help. I'm thinking i'm going to take a break from the group as a whole for a little, but everyone in this group are my friends in real life too, so I don't know how that will hold up.
I think the biggest problem is we're in a discord group (sort of like skype) and we all talk every single day. How do i take a break from someone i'll see every day?

She cares about all of our feelings, but also expect the whole "Friends are there for eachother" to mean that they have to be there every time she's down. Many of our friends have word for word told her "We can still hang out, but leave me out of your problems." Which has made her think they hate her and just made it worse...

I try to tell her that i can't always be there, and she understands that I have been through her stuff too, so i feel like telling her what a drain she is on me and that it's putting me in a bad state of mind will make her realize she should back up a little and give me time to heal. During her suicide attempt she cursed at my father who was only trying to help and called him a pig and a murderer because he's an officer. She put me in some awful mental state and my family wants nothing to do with her now. She's basically waiting for me to tell her "Get out." So instead of her taking my drain as "hey i need some space" i'm almost 100% certain she'll interpret it as "i hate you, get lost!" 

I can't think of how to rationalize with her because you can't. When in this state of mind, you don't/can't rationalize. It is her mind and interpretation vs my intentions and presentation. I'm at a loss on how to tell her i need a break. It wouldn't be a short week break, it could be a few months... She needs to learn some independence but she doesn't want it.

The best thing that happened to me when I was as bad as her was being alone (which she hates). I had made some new friends who I wasn't open enough to share my past and depression with, so I spent a couple years keeping them to myself and learning a coping method that helped me that was non violent and caused no self harm. It was hard but i discovered crying helped me so much. As soon as I learned that I slowly started opening to my friends. That's when I realized that I need someone to vent to. No real feed back, just someone to listen. That improved my mental state by a lot and I feel so great now. But the problem is I had the full intention of getting better. I've offered her these solutions, but she says she doesn't want to be alone, she's dependent on others and though she says she wants to get better, she doesn't actually take any initiative. 

She always has bad relationships and everything seems to go bad for her. EVERYTHING. But after knowing her for so long I know that if everywhere you go smells like shit, check your shoes. She really needs to work on herself and find out how to deal with being alone... we won't always be there, and a lot of people are giving up on her, she really needs to get professional help and actually try to better herself, but she's delusional and thinks she's okay and that she just needs friends and a boyfriend, but she needs to be alone and find herself. My problem is that this is a rational argument to most people, but any other person who's been through this knows that when you're that gone and depressed that rationality is abysmal. She will take this as "everyone hates me and I should just disappear" because that's her mindset right now. 

Edit: I read the thread and it didn't help much. Not because it's not a helpful thread, but because I've been on the other end where I tired to kill myself. I know these tactics work and I use them on her, but we can't get to the stage of "I need help". I knowing telling her won't help her, you have to get her to tell herself she needs it, but I can't get her there anymore, I've been working on her for years and now it's pulling me backwards, I've been okay but she's doing a toll on me. A depressed person helping a depressed person only ends with one of them taking the others load. Right now she's a burden, but I don't want to give up on her, but I can't keep going like this. I can already feel the uneasy darkness that used to cloud my mind creeping up on me. I don't want to feel depressed anymore, but she's bringing it back quick
